posts.cooked:
It’s pretty definitely not canon, but my answer to where Progeny’s name came from is that Captain Cosmic met a well concealed Nixious the Chosen, or maybe some lesser member of Nix’s cult, who recognized the description of this kind of monster and said "it is the progeny of the Great Destroyer to come, sent to destroy whatever is beneath His dread notice ".

I also really want to imagine the lesser form of Progeny as being bronze, with a symbol that signifies an even lesser degree of convergence. (Edit: the symbol that fits best is probably just six circles in a hexagon pattern with a seventh circle in the middle.)

Animalverse version: Prawngeny. (I was originally going to go with Piranhageny, but that’s spelled too misleadingly for how you’d say it for that to be right.)

(I’m too SethH for my puns, too SethH for my puns, so SethH yeah it hurts…)
